family.description: This family includes Cilia- and flagella-associated protein 141 (CFAP141, also known as C1orf189 protein). Members of this family may be microtubule inner proteins (MIP) part of the dynein-decorated doublet microtubules (DMTs) in cilia axoneme, which is required for motile cilia beating [[cite:PUB00100771]].
family.name: Cilia- and flagella-associated protein 141
